post.description:
Sandbox (Testing): https://gateway.sand.us.zip.co/orders/authorize

Creates a new checkout context and redirects to the checkout website using details from the request body.

Sent from the user's browser via a form POST, will start a checkout session within Zip. It will automatically redirect the user to our Zip checkout. You need to ensure you provide your merchant ID, merchant reference (the unique ID you use for the order in your system), confirm/cancel URLs, and the order amount. The order amount should include all shipping, tax, and discount charges. You do not need to provide the order ID as that will be generated for you. Passing as much customer information as possible will improve the user experience by pre-filling data fields and improving conversion.

orderId.description: Gets or sets the unique ID to use for order creation

merchantId.description: Gets or sets the merchant Id

merchantReference.description: Gets or sets the unique merchant reference for this authorization.

order.description: Encapsulates an order to create for a merchant

firstName.description: Gets or sets the customer's first name.

lastName.description: Gets or sets the customer's last name.

email.description: Gets or sets the customer's email address.

phone.description: Gets or sets the customer's phone number.

line1.description: Gets or sets the first address line.

line2.description: Gets or sets the second address line.

state.description: Gets or sets the state or province.

postalCode.description: Gets or sets the postal code.

sku.description: Gets or sets the SKU identifier of the item being purchased.

isPreOrder.description: Gets or sets the flag indicating whether or not this item will be included in a preorder

releaseDate.description: Gets or sets the date a preorder order will be shipped

orderNumber.description: Gets or sets the Zip order number.

test.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a test order

capture.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this order should be immediately captured

callbackUrl.description: Gets or sets the status callback url

redirectCancelUrl.description: Gets or sets the url that the user will be redirected to if they cancel the checkout

redirectConfirmUrl.description: Gets or sets the url that the user will be redirected to after they have completed the checkout.

metadata.description: Gets or sets optional metadata attached to the checkout

checkoutFlow.description: Gets or sets the type of the checkout; defaults to Standard; can only be set internally

brandName.description: Gets or sets the brand name of the merchant for this order

post.description:
Sandbox (Testing): https://gateway.sand.us.zip.co/orders/{orderId}/capture

Captures funds for the specified order. Only applicable to pay-on-ship/deferred fund capture merchants. If sync query parameter is set to true, replies synchronously with callback payload, otherwise, replies asynchronously on callback URL. Default sync value is false for asynchronous behavior.

currency.description: Gets or sets the Currency of the capture

amount.description: Gets or sets the Amount of the capture

merchantReference.description: Gets or sets the Merchant Reference of the capture

singleCapture.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether or not the order will only be captured once. In that case if the capture value is less than the order value, the remainder will be voided.

callbackUrl.description: Gets or sets the url to callback with the capture result

test.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a test order

Metadata.description: Gets or sets optional metadata associated with this capture

post.description:
Sandbox (Testing): https://gateway.sand.us.zip.co/orders/{orderId}/refund

Refunds funds for the specified order and allocates them to the payment plan to apply it to the customer. If sync query parameter is set to true, replies synchronously with callback payload, otherwise, replies asynchronously on callback URL.

Default sync value is false for asynchronous behavior.

If you are a pay-on-ship/DFC merchant, you can only apply up to your captured amount.

currency.description: Gets or sets the Currency of the capture

amount.description: Gets or sets the Amount of the capture

merchantReference.description: Gets or sets the Merchant Reference of the capture

callbackUrl.description: Gets or sets the url to callback with the refund result

test.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a test order

metadata.description: Gets or sets optional metadata associated with this capture

post.description:
Sandbox (Testing): https://gateway.sand.us.zip.co/orders/{orderId}/void

Voids uncaptured funds for the specified order and allocates them to the payment plan to apply it to the customer. Only applicable to pay-on-ship/deferred fund capture merchants. If sync query parameter is set to true, replies synchronously with callback payload, otherwise, replies asynchronously on callback URL. Default sync value is false for asynchronous behavior.

currency.description: Gets or sets the Currency of the capture

amount.description: Gets or sets the Amount of the capture

merchantReference.description: Gets or sets the Merchant Reference of the capture

callbackUrl.description: Gets or sets the url to callback with the void result

test.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a test order

metadata.description: Gets or sets optional metadata associated with this capture

isAmountInCommand.description: Gets or sets a flag indicating whether or not the command amount is set and not defaulted. By default, the void amount is included in the command.

post.description:
Sandbox (Testing): https://gateway.sand.us.zip.co/orders/{orderId}/confirm

Confirms the supplied authorized order and initiates the payment plan for the customer. If sync query parameter is set to true, replies synchronously with callback payload, otherwise, replies asynchronously on callback URL. Default sync value is false for asynchronous behavior.

Merchants using the Standard Checkout with the mobile SDK will allow customers to use the Zip checkout without starting an order until this API call is made by the merchant. This same feature can be leveraged for standard online checkouts as well. The payment plan for the customer will not begin until a successful callback is received by the merchant for this operation. This operation does allow merchants to add shipping/taxes after the Zip checkout for the order. This will be processed with the currency of the original order. This functionality is enabled upon request. Please work with the integration team during onboarding if this is needed in your implementation.

amount.description: Gets or sets the Amount of the capture

shippingAmount.description: Gets or sets the optional shipping amount associated with the order.

taxAmount.description: Gets or sets the optional tax amount associated with the order

merchantReference.description: Gets or sets the Merchant Reference of the capture

callbackUrl.description: Gets or sets the url to callback with the confirm result

test.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a test order

metadata.description: Gets or sets optional metadata associated with this capture
